meta.what: Marin'Or Ivoire timbre-marmite: faceted flame geometry (spec §3, 4.4, 5, 6.2, 6.3, 7)
meta.units: flame-local CSS px at 100 % scale (@1x canvas 1080x1350)
meta.local_frame: origin = base centre, +x right, +y DOWN, the flame grows towards -y

placement.svgTransform: translate(627 647) rotate(14) scale(sx sy)  (sx, sy = scaleX/100, scaleY/100)
placement.css: left:0;top:0; transform-origin:0 0; transform: translate(627px,647px) rotate(14deg) scale(sx,sy)

out.note: #FFA53A towards the tips (as on the printed flames), #FF6B31 at the base

layers.glitter: composition: glitter texture, screen 70 %, matte = core
layers.glow: composition: OUT blurred 24 px, screen 35 % (safe-zone check uses a 24 px margin)

skirt.note: vertices 0/14 (and 1/13) form a hidden skirt below the base line: the inner front lip of the pot is ~100 px below E, so a 30 px extension would leave the base edge floating in the pot interior. Bottom y of every layer = skirtY - inset (out 0, mid 18, core 37); x never changes. framePlan.skirtY gives the depth that keeps all bottoms under opaque pot_front for that frame's scale. z-order: pot_back < flame < pot_front.

meta.interpolation: all poses share the same vertex order and count per layer; collapsed tongues are zero-area spikes (tip on the chord between its notches, or all three vertices merged). framePlan blends lerp OUT; frames[] holds the exact baked layers to draw.
meta.rule_no_text: no text/letters/numbers in any visual output
